title: Get LLM costs
description: Fetch daily LLM cost per model for the project over the last N days (default 7). Runs a trends query summing $ai_total_cost_usd on $ai_generation events broken down by $ai_model — call when the user asks how much the team is spending on LLMs or which model costs the most. For the current user's own spend use llma-personal-spend; for custom cost cuts (per user, per trace, per provider) query $ai_generation events with execute-sql.
